test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). A is sitting second to the right of E. Only one person is sitting between D and A. B is sitting third to the right of G. F is an immediate neighbour of B. How many people are sitting between D and E when counted from the left of E?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

A is sitting second to the right of E. Only one person is sitting between D and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f0e3d04181886ed9a524205cd91b7295b14ee6c24e10f5d993623b99b77a113.png] 

B is sitting third to the right of G. F is an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af97b6de3b965863755f9e7a427fc3b621aff5aad0e16d2aa3d577dfae935ee9.png] 

Thus, Only two people are sitting between D and E when counted from the left of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
